items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Nobody could play the bass, I could play for Bud Scott. Bud Scott didn't think, you know. You're a solid bass player, you're solid.

ctx.x: Yeah. He really used to do it too. He'd get out. They'd mute those horns, you know. And that's where your bass and your rhythm sticks out, you see. The rhythm sticks out. But not too much of them. They play that when you play it soft. And I'd be making the full beat.…
